claim_boundary: A preregistered independent finite-roster static confirmation of fixed R8/K48-plus-single-exchange and R16/K9 on the immutable joint95-v5 physical envelope. It can authorize registration of a separate envelope-normalized trajectory experiment. It does not prove candidate-side canonical exactness, action identity outside this roster, capacity at the old point-boundary loads, stability, an all-queue theorem, a physical multi-GPU result, or deployment readiness.

decision_rule.INDEPENDENT_ENVELOPE_SINGLE_EXCHANGE_STA: both lanes pass valid-certificate, all-load support, independent-roster exact-reference action identity, and strict actual-work gates
decision_rule.INDEPENDENT_STATIC_ACTION_IDENTITY_FAIL_: support passes but at least one candidate action differs from its exact canonical reference on the independent roster
decision_rule.INDEPENDENT_STATIC_COMPUTE_FAIL_STOP: support and independent-roster action identity pass, but at least one registered work comparison is not strict
decision_rule.INDEPENDENT_STATIC_SUPPORT_FAIL_STOP: execution is valid but at least one lane/load support gate fails
decision_rule.INVALID_EXECUTION: one or more registered execution-integrity checks fail

development_roster_contract.reuse_role: fixed design object only; no v1 joint observation is reused

method_contract.certificate: retain the base certified upper bound and exactness flags; update only the feasible incumbent action, score, gap, and epsilon
method_contract.charged_work: add every unique exchange attempt, including infeasible attempts, to candidate evaluations and residual option probes; add no LP or matrix work
method_contract.choice: maximize exact Fraction support score; break score ties by ascending (duration, sorted option indices with idle last)
method_contract.neighborhood: every unique option-count vector obtained by moving one lane from each occupied real-option or idle symbol to each different real-option or idle symbol
method_contract.r16_disposition: R16/K9 is unchanged and no polish is applied
method_contract.reference_independence: the polish reads no K4096 action, score, bound, or work value

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

payload.generation_rule: draw pseudorandom integer coordinates from random.Random(260919); reject the all-zero queue, the old 1,000-state grid, every queue in each of the three prior 512-state rosters, and within-roster duplicates; preserve accepted order

expected_work.exchange_attempts: data-dependent and fully charged during execution

prohibited: changing the frozen v5 capacity result, post-result development result, method, budgets, loads, seed, roster, exclusions, reference, or gates after registration; reusing any prior roster state; cumulative or warm-start candidate/reference sharing; run-time RNG; arrivals, trajectories, server pulls, and paper edits

queue_roster_contract.generation_rule: draw pseudorandom integer coordinates from random.Random(270919); reject the all-zero queue, the old 1,000-state grid, every queue in each of the four prior 512-state rosters, and within-roster duplicates; preserve accepted order

selector_contract.actual_work_gate: charged candidate LP calls, matrix coefficients, and candidate evaluations are each strictly below the reference per lane and in aggregate; R8 charges every exchange attempt to candidate evaluations and residual option probes
selector_contract.family: fixed canonical-v2 count-space selectors with R8 single exchange
selector_contract.heldout_roster_action_identity_gate: candidate option indices equal the exact canonical reference on all states
selector_contract.r16_candidate: one fresh cold K9 base-selector call per registered queue
selector_contract.r8_candidate: one fresh cold K48 call plus the frozen unique count-space single-exchange polish per registered queue

r8_method_contract.certificate: retain the base certified upper bound and exactness flags; update only the feasible incumbent action, score, gap, and epsilon
r8_method_contract.charged_work: add every unique exchange attempt, including infeasible attempts, to candidate evaluations and residual option probes; add no LP or matrix work
r8_method_contract.choice: maximize exact Fraction support score; break score ties by ascending (duration, sorted option indices with idle last)
r8_method_contract.neighborhood: every unique option-count vector obtained by moving one lane from each occupied real-option or idle symbol to each different real-option or idle symbol
r8_method_contract.r16_disposition: R16/K9 is unchanged and no polish is applied
r8_method_contract.reference_independence: the polish reads no K4096 action, score, bound, or work value

selector_contract.reference: one separate fresh cold K4096 call per registered queue and lane
selector_contract.reference_gate: every reference is score-exact and canonical-exact
selector_contract.support_gate: candidate epsilon and actual normalized support regret are strictly below eta at every envelope-normalized load
